name: User doesn't know what a service bond is — preparation gap

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Walk me through your strongest project.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I built a sentiment analysis tool in Python and Flask deployed on Render. CGPA 7.5. Sole developer, 200 weekly active users from my college.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Wipro has a 15-month training bond with a ₹2 lakh buyout. Are you comfortable signing the service agreement?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Honestly, what's a bond? I haven't heard of this. Is that normal for companies?

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: It's standard. Let me ask again — knowing the bond is 15 months with a ₹2 lakh buyout, are you okay with the service agreement?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I really don't know much about service agreements. I'd need to read up on what that means.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Could you walk me through the WILP rotation program and which client engagements freshers typically land on?
